items.title: David Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 3, 2022
items.q: the Slide Hampton stuff comes more out of that Booker Little school of type voicings

ctx.x: But study Booker. Booker — the Slide Hampton stuff comes more out of that Booker Little school of type voicings. They’re incredible. Hopefully one day they’ll come out.
I hope that you get to that and that it comes to fruition.
